about: Sitting 4, fourth go, written by hand on 7 Oct 2026 at the owner's word: 'They look good. But the issue is the spacing of the doors. Its not uniform, some doors are touching and others have a gap. We need them uniform.' Two ways in one file, from the third go's version A (six doors, solid right wall): one named change (the spacing), and the corridor laid out again from words with that picture as its look.
